skill.name: web-scraper
skill.description: Design web scraping and data collection systems for static pages, dynamic sites, APIs, storage pipelines, distributed crawlers, and authorized traffic analysis.
skill.summary: Build maintainable data collectors with practical Python templates, validation, storage, monitoring, and compliance guidance.
skill.author: zl2023github

security_audit.summary: Most command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, and the credential findings show normal parameters or local placeholders. Confirmed risks involve public proxy routing, unredacted response storage, anti-bot evasion, and capture of sensitive traffic.

remediation.issue: The guidance teaches fingerprint spoofing, CAPTCHA automation, and ignoring robots.txt.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit authorization and remove examples that bypass access controls or site crawling policies.

remediation.issue: Traffic interception examples print headers and bodies and save complete responses.
remediation.suggestion: Redact credentials and personal data, restrict approved domains, encrypt storage, and define retention limits.

remediation.issue: The proxy pool trusts a public proxy feed and routes requests through unaudited servers.
remediation.suggestion: Use trusted authenticated proxies, validate feed integrity, and never send credentials through public proxies.

content.value_statement: Web data collection often breaks when pages, APIs, or defenses change. This skill provides practical templates for extraction, cleaning, storage, validation, and monitoring.
actual_capabilities: Selects suitable tools for static pages, dynamic sites, APIs, and distributed collection.
Provides Python examples using Requests, Beautiful Soup, Scrapy, Playwright, pandas, and MongoDB.
Explains pagination, retries, delays, deduplication, cleaning, storage, and validation.
Outlines Redis-backed scheduling and operational health checks for larger crawlers.
Shows authorized mitmproxy workflows for inspecting application requests and responses.
Includes compliance checks for robots.txt, privacy, copyright, rate limits, and service terms.
limitations: Examples require adaptation, dependency installation, and testing before production use.
Selectors and target APIs can change without notice and require ongoing maintenance.
The skill does not provide legal authorization to collect data or bypass access controls.
Distributed deployment, credential management, and production security remain implementation responsibilities.

use_cases.title: Collect Public Research Data
use_cases.description: Create a rate-limited collector for permitted public pages, then normalize and validate the extracted records.

use_cases.title: Monitor Product Information
use_cases.description: Build a scheduled pipeline that tracks approved product fields and reports structural changes or missing data.

use_cases.title: Maintain Collection Infrastructure
use_cases.description: Design retries, deduplication, storage, health checks, and distributed queues for an authorized crawler.

prompt_templates.title: Scrape a Static Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Python scraper for [URL] that extracts [fields]. Respect robots.txt, rate limits, and terms. Return CSV-ready records.

prompt_templates.title: Collect Dynamic Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Playwright collector for [URL]. Wait for [selector], paginate safely, extract [fields], and describe failure handling.

prompt_templates.title: Build an API Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an authenticated API collector for [endpoint]. Add pagination, retries, rate limiting, deduplication, validation, and secure credential handling.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Crawler
prompt_templates.prompt: Architect an authorized crawler for [scope] and [volume]. Include queues, storage, monitoring, privacy controls, retention, and recovery procedures.

output_examples.input: Extract article titles, dates, and links from an approved static news archive.
output_examples.output: A collector plan with selectors, pagination rules, polite delays, validation checks, and a table containing normalized article records.

output_examples.input: Monitor a permitted dynamic catalog for price and availability changes.
output: A Playwright workflow with explicit waits and bounded pagination.
A normalized product table with change timestamps.
Alerts for selector failures, missing fields, and request errors.

output_examples.input: Design a daily API ingestion job for an authorized business endpoint.
output_examples.output: A pipeline specification covering secret storage, cursor pagination, retries, deduplication, schema validation, persistence, metrics, and recovery.

best_practices: Confirm authorization, robots.txt rules, service terms, privacy requirements, and acceptable request rates before collection.
Use timeouts, bounded retries, backoff, caching, stable selectors, and per-domain concurrency limits.
Protect credentials and collected data with redaction, access controls, encryption, retention limits, and audit logs.
anti_patterns: Do not bypass CAPTCHAs, access controls, authentication, or anti-abuse systems without explicit authorization.
Do not route credentials or sensitive data through free public proxies.
Do not log complete headers, cookies, request bodies, or responses without redaction and approved retention.

faq.question: Which sites can this skill collect from?
faq.answer: Use it only for sources where collection is authorized by law, service terms, robots.txt, and the data owner.

faq.question: Does it support JavaScript-rendered pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Playwright patterns for navigation, explicit waits, scrolling, and browser-based extraction.

faq.question: Can it build Scrapy projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides spider, pagination, delay, retry, pipeline, and Redis scheduling patterns that require project-specific adaptation.

faq.question: How should API keys be handled?
faq.answer: Store keys in an approved secret manager and redact them from logs, files, prompts, and error reports.

faq.question: Does it guarantee stable extraction?
faq.answer: No. Websites and APIs change, so selectors, schemas, tests, monitoring, and maintenance remain necessary.

faq.question: Can it bypass anti-bot controls?
faq.answer: The source discusses evasion methods, but they should not be used without explicit authorization from the target owner.
